# Blou (tryblou.com) — agent-readable site summary

## Brand

Name: Blou
Tagline: Quit smoking, tracked simply.
Category: Quit-smoking tracker / smoking cessation app (iOS)
Primary conversion: App Store download
Not medical advice: educational content cites NHS, CDC, WHO, US Surgeon General public guidance

## Mechanism

1. Make the quit visible (streak, money saved, lung recovery milestones)
2. Interrupt cravings with a short timer + pre-committed 2-minute action
3. Content hub supports quit planning and withdrawal questions

## Pricing

- App: free core tracking; optional premium (details on App Store)
- Website: free guides, tools, calculators

## Platform

- iOS app: live on App Store (id6758997298)
- Android: waitlist at https://tryblou.com/#android-waitlist
